title: The Application as Extraction Surface: Semantic Labor, Induced Preparation, and Institutional Opacity in the Anthropic Fellows Screening Process
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
The first **Extractive Reliance Study**, applying Semantic Economy accounting to labor induced by a fellowship-screening process. The report analyzes communications in the Anthropic Fellows application process administered through Constellation and asks how a stated timeline, reaffirmed assessment process, applicant preparation, and unresolved status combined to transfer the cost of ambiguity to the applicant.

The single-case audit covers the documentary record through May 21, 2026. It estimates 30–40 hours of preparation at a documented consulting rate of $150 per hour, producing a direct monetary estimate of $4,500–$6,000 before tool, opportunity, emotional, bodily, and credibility costs. It alleges neither bad faith nor unlawful conduct and makes no claim of selection entitlement. Later clarifying communication would require a delta note.
